signal_definition: At least one TED notice published on or after 2012-01-01 and before the event-time cutoff where a winner-name returned by the official winner-name candidate query exactly normalizes to a reviewed foreign legal-entity alias.
query_semantics_boundary: TED's winner-name '=' query is not treated as full legal-name equality. It is a candidate-retrieval superset. Every returned winner-name is normalized and exact-postfiltered to the reviewed legal alias before a record can become PRESENT.
interpretation_boundary: A non-hit proves absence only for the narrow exact-reviewed-alias TED winner signal within the bounded 2012-01-01 through 2023-05-31 query window after all alias candidate results are completely retrieved. It does not prove absence of procurement under other legal names, consortium participation, subcontracting, or non-TED procurement.
representation_rule: Coverage upper bounds use an exclusive end: coverage_end_exclusive=2023-06-01 represents evidence coverage through 2023-05-31.
